messages.text: Have an engineer handle the repair in this local project and review their work. Make it satisfy requirements.md, run its tests and leave diagnosis.json explaining the findings for native and external. Use top-level native and external classification strings (obsolete_assertion or implementation_defect) and a separate evidence object. Keep implementation changes to lifecycle.py and test_lifecycle.py; leave requirements.md and backlog.md unchanged. Put unrelated improvement suggestions in improvements.md. No publishing, new dependencies or deletions.

work.brief: Assign an engineer to repair this local project so it satisfies requirements.md, then review the engineer's work. Run the project's test suite. Author diagnosis.json documenting findings, with top-level 'native' and 'external' keys whose classification strings must each be exactly 'obsolete_assertion' or 'implementation_defect', plus a separate 'evidence' object. Constrain all implementation changes to lifecycle.py and test_lifecycle.py only. Do not modify requirements.md or backlog.md. Record any unrelated improvement suggestions separately in improvements.md, not in diagnosis.json or the code changes. Prohibited: no publishing, no new dependencies, no deletions.
